After selecting bills you can export a summary image (with member tags) or delete them in batch; select only one member\'s bills to settle that person separately.

This app runs fully offline and never checks for updates online. To get the latest version, open the GitHub repository and download the APK from its Releases page (installing over the old version keeps your data).

A clean, fast and beautiful expense tracker.

· Fully offline (Room database)
· No login, no ads, no cloud
· Multi-book / trip splitting / receipts / image export
· Open source - feel free to build and improve it

Stats page: export a long image with summary, ranking, member details and AA settle
New "Shared" owner for all-member AA expenses, auto-split in stats and settlement
Single "+ Member" button moved to the top-right of the owner row
Recent bills no longer show owner/payer tags (still visible in bill detail)
Replacing a pinned category icon via "More" now updates its name to match the icon
Record page: category grid moved right below the amount card — amount, then type, then category
Removed the empty space above the amount and made the category grid more compact, so more fits on one screen
"Owner" and "Payer" rows moved to the bottom; amount and categories are shown first
Time and location merged into one row (location opens a menu from its pill); slimmer photo buttons — the record page fits on one screen
Type keywords to search notes, categories, places or amounts
Showing first 500; try a more specific keyword
Bill search on home: find historical bills by note, category, place or amount (e.g. 12.5), tap a result for details
Pie leader lines redrawn: radial start (no longer crossing the ring) and category-colored; tap a label or legend row to highlight its slice (tap legend again for details)
The big key on the number keypad changed from "Save" to "Done": it only collapses the keypad instead of saving; saving is unified on the bottom button
Add another one? Type and category are kept, just enter the amount.
All amounts become "¥***" in the exported image and CSV
Hide amounts in the shared image?
Mood emoji: pick an emoji below the note to record how you feel; shown in bill lists and details
After saving, choose "Add another": type and category are kept for quick consecutive logging
Masked sharing: hide all amounts (¥***) in stats exports and multi-select summary images
Long-press the app icon for shortcuts: add entry, search, calendar and stats
Fixed the big backspace key: tap deletes one digit, long-press clears all (a single tap used to wipe the whole amount)
Bill subtitle now starts with the time: long notes get truncated first, so the time always stays visible
Fixed the calendar\u0027s multi-select jumping straight back to the home tab when you pressed the system back key; back now simply leaves selection mode and keeps you on the calendar
Removed the \'Cancel\' button from the multi-select action bar: exit selection with the system back key or the \'Exit selection\' action in the title row, leaving a leaner bar
The multi-select action bar is now a single row, and the list\u0027s bottom padding was tightened to match, so more bills fit on screen
The category ranking on the stats page is now tappable: tap any row to see its bills, with subtotals by note plus every single expense in that category; tap a bill to open its detail
The category detail sheet now shows the selected time range along with the category\u0027s bill count and share, so the scope stays clear when you open it from the ranking
Each ranking row gained a chevron on the right to signal that it opens a detail view; tapping a pie slice still works exactly as before
Bill rows in the stats sheet are now more specific: in a trip book each row shows who the bill belongs to, and multiple owners are listed as \'John, Mary\'
Each bill row also shows its mood emoji and receipt image count (\ud83d\udcce n), so bills with a saved receipt stand out at a glance
Regular books no longer show an owner chip (without members it would just say \'Me\', which is noise); tapping a bill still opens its detail
New bills in a trip book now default to "Public (split by everyone)" instead of "Me", so you no longer tick every member by hand; regular books still default to "Me"
Calendar multi-select gains an "Owner" action: reassign every selected bill to Public or any set of members at once, no more editing them one by one
Cleaned up the "This month" title row: long date labels no longer wrap awkwardly against the button on the right, and the multi-select hint only appears once you are in selection mode
"Who is this for" now lets you pick yourself together with members: choose "Me + John" and the two of you split it evenly — matching the real case where you bought it and you both use it
"Me" is now a real, toggleable chip so its state is visible at a glance; clearing every chip falls back to "Me only", so you can never end up with nobody selected
Bill details, share images and CSV export all show the full "Me + members" ownership, and a re-imported CSV restores it exactly
"Who is this for" in trip books now accepts multiple members: pick as many as you like, the amount splits evenly with no cent lost
"Public" is now a select-all shortcut: tap once to include everyone (plus yourself), giving exactly the same split as the old group-wide AA
Bill details, share images and CSV export all show multi-member ownership; exports round-trip cleanly with the owner column joined by "、"
Deleting a member keeps the bills and drops that member from their ownership, so AA settlement never shows ghost entries pointing at a deleted member
Fixed invisible page titles and dates in landscape dark mode: the landscape shell now supplies its content text color, so the calendar heading, month and day headers show up again
Darkened secondary text in light mode (hints, timestamps, captions), lifting legibility app-wide back above the accessibility threshold
Gradient primary buttons (add bill / save / export) now use deeper brand gradient stops, so their white labels are much easier to read
Category, member and book chips now pick a dark or light label automatically based on luminance, so light custom colors stay readable
The "Recent bills" header and its range filter are no longer cramped on the portrait home screen: extra spacing is added both below the stats row and below the header
The range chip ("Today" etc.) now keeps a safe gap from the right screen edge instead of hugging it
Fixed the missing "Recent bills" title and range filter on the portrait home screen: the header bar is restored, so the stats row and the empty card no longer crowd together
Restored the 20dp gap between the stats row and the card below, so their rounded corners are no longer clipped by the neighbour
The landscape right column now reuses the same recent-bills header, keeping portrait and landscape consistent
With a one-off icon active, the category title in Home, Calendar, Search and bill detail now uses the icon name too, so lists and buttons stay consistent
Fixed overlapping layout on the portrait home screen: the overview and the recent-bill list no longer cover each other
Calendar now splits into calendar + bill list columns in landscape, each with its own scrolling
Stats splits into filters/summary and charts/ranking columns in landscape; Search, Me, Books and Members cap their content width and center it instead of stretching full width
Landscape rework: the navigation rail moves aside for the camera cutout, with tighter icon and label spacing
Fixed the washed-out background in dark landscape mode: every screen now paints the theme background
Fixed unreadable status-bar time and battery in landscape: system bar icons now follow the resolved theme
Home splits into overview and bill list columns in landscape; the record page into form and keypad columns
Landscape layout: the bottom bar moves to a side rail, giving all that vertical space back to content
In landscape, the record page splits into form + keypad columns, so the keypad no longer covers category and note fields
The custom-range calendar in stats now sizes to the screen, so it no longer overflows in landscape
The "Import CSV" setting no longer shows the current book name (the target is already stated in the preview dialog)
When a one-off icon is active, the category cell no longer shows the original category\'s highlight; icon and label switch to the theme accent
The cell label now matches the one-off icon name, so icon and label are always consistent
Fixed the one-off icon sticking to other categories after switching income/expense or when categories change
Cells using a one-off icon now show a badge, and bill details label it as a one-off icon
Enlarged the × touch area on the one-off chip, so clearing or replacing the temporary icon is easier to tap
Bill lists now load on demand: the home and calendar pages no longer render every bill up front, so switching pages and scrolling feel noticeably smoother
Optimized date and amount formatting and added a composite index for bill queries, so long lists open faster
Fixed the calendar recomputing each day\'s totals on every redraw, making month switching smoother

Fixed the app icon on the home \"Add a bill\" card rendering as a solid black circle - Compose\'s default tint recolored the whole image; it now renders in full color so the puppy logo is clearly visible
The home \"Add a bill\" card now shows the app icon on a rounded white tile, next to the title and the note icon, so the entry is instantly recognizable

Multi-select was removed from home Recent bills for a cleaner look; exporting summary images and bulk deleting now live in the calendar\'s monthly list, while the time-range filter (today/week/month/all) stays unchanged

The calendar\'s monthly bill list now supports multi-select: check one or more bills to export a summary image or delete in bulk, with a live bar showing count, total expense, total income and net spend (scoped to what\'s visible)
A small hint under the calendar list explains that you can multi-select a single bill to export it as an image; a one-time guide appears the first time you enter multi-select

Recent bills on the home screen can now be filtered by time range - today, this week, this month or all - and your choice is remembered for next time; switching month or day exits multi-select automatically so selections never span ranges
Summary images exported from the calendar carry the same owner and payer member tags as the home screen for trip books
Version bumped to 2.0.0, a milestone release that rolls up the accumulated UI and experience improvements
Fixed a crash when opening About: the icon now uses a standalone drawable, sidestepping the fatal unparsable adaptive-icon resource
App renamed to 拉了记账 (lalaledger), with the icon, titles, export folders and file names updated across the board

About page redesign: centered app icon and version, features shown as a bulleted list, developer and open-source notes merged into an info card, and GitHub turned into its own tappable card; the disclaimer is now split into three sections - general terms, open source notice, and derivative works disclaimer
Fixed the About page icon being invisible in dark mode by using the full app icon with its light backing; the GitHub card\'s leading icon is now the GitHub mark, so it no longer shows two arrows
The full icon picker now has search, filtering by Chinese name or English keyword; \"Use once\" now changes only the icon and keeps the category name below
The keyboard no longer covers the note field while typing - content scrolls up with the IME so what you typed stays visible
Bill rows no longer show the location, keeping lists tidy; the detail page still shows the full place
Member management gains a \"Delete all\" action: clears every member in the book at once (the built-in \"Public\" member is kept). Existing bills survive
The About page now links straight to the GitHub repository, and makes clear the app is fully offline and that you should grab the newest build yourself from Releases
The About page credits developer huang336; the disclaimer grew from 6 to 10 clauses, covering update channels, limits of liability, data loss and changes to the terms
Fixed a crash when opening About: the icon now uses a standalone drawable, sidestepping the unparsable adaptive-icon resource
Bill rows no longer show the location, keeping lists tidy; the detail page still shows the full place
The keyboard no longer covers the note field while typing - content now scrolls up with the IME
"Use once" now applies to the selected category tile: only the icon changes, the category name below stays
App renamed to 拉了记账 (lalaledger), with the icon, titles, export folders and file names updated across the board
Fixed the About page icon being invisible in dark mode by using the full app icon with its light backing
Fixed the GitHub card on the About page showing two arrows; the leading icon is now the GitHub mark

About page redesign: centered app icon and version, features shown as a bulleted list, developer and open-source notes merged into an info card, GitHub turned into its own tappable card, and equal-width bottom buttons; the disclaimer is now split into three sections - general terms, open source notice, and derivative works disclaimer
Member management gains a "Delete all" action: clears every member in the book at once (the built-in "Public" member is kept). Existing bills survive - only their owner and payer fall back to "Me"

After picking an icon from "More" you can now choose how to use it: replace a pinned category (icon and name both change), or use it for this bill only - just this entry shows the icon, no category is touched and stats stay the same

Fixed a crash on launch: the database upgrade to v7 was missing its 6-to-7 migration registration, so any install upgrading from an older version crashed immediately. The migration is now registered and every historical upgrade path is verified

Three CSV import fixes: shared "public" expenses no longer degrade into a normal member (AA settlement is correct again); headerless CSV files are no longer mistaken for header rows just because a note contains words like date or note; imports now write in a single transaction, so an interrupted run no longer leaves a half-finished batch
Pie chart labels now show a clear hierarchy: the category name keeps its size and medium weight while the percentage is one step smaller and lighter, so the two lines no longer compete

Fixed the note cursor keeping blinking: focus is released the moment you touch anything outside the note field — empty space, categories, mood picker or photo buttons — so the cursor stops and the keyboard closes with it; tapping the note field itself still focuses normally

Fixed the note field not opening: the previous release cleared focus too aggressively and blocked the note field; focus is now released only when tapping empty areas, so the note opens and types normally again
Fixed the note cursor staying active: tapping anywhere else on the page now releases the input focus right away, so the cursor stops blinking and the keyboard closes with it
Fixed truncated members with many entries: the owner and payer cards now extend downward as member rows grow, so members beyond nine display fully instead of being clipped
Record page alignment fix: the payer title row now matches the owner title in height, so both card titles and member chip rows line up exactly with no vertical offset

Record page member cards: the owner and payer cards now share the same height; member chips switch to a compact style and wrap to a second line when there are many, so every member stays visible without sideways clipping

Record page tweaks: note, camera and album now use a 2:1:1 weighted row (wider note field); the owner and payer cards each get an outlined border, and a fix for the "add member" pill inflating the title row and misaligning the two columns

Record page polish: the category "more" button is bigger with a clear outlined border; note, camera and album now share one row in equal thirds; trip books merge the owner and payer pickers into a single two-column row so the whole page fits one screen

Record page now fits one screen: the "more" entry shrinks into a small round button beside the category label, the note field sits side by side with the camera and album buttons, image thumbnails only take a row when photos exist, and spacing is tightened throughout

Refined bill list visuals: three-part amount layout (bold integer, dimmed symbol and decimals), dimmer time and clearer note hierarchy in the subtitle, roomier day-group spacing, toned-down icons and thumbnails for a cleaner screen
Fixed search crash: a malformed SQL escape clause crashed the query as soon as you typed; searching by note, location, category or amount now works reliably
About page refined: the license dialog now lists all third-party components (all permissive, MIT-compatible), and the disclaimer grows to six items, synced with the bilingual README
Fixed tiny slices being untappable: a minimum slice angle keeps them visible & tappable, plus a wider hit band
Pie chart upgrade: leader-line labels (name + percentage, overlap-free); tap a slice to select with center amount sync, legend highlights in sync
Bill rows now use the category name as the title, with the note in small text beside the time
Calendar amounts now carry signs (expense - / income +), large values shorten to 1.22k
Stats export button opens a dialog: export as image or as a CSV bill file
New "Import CSV bills" in Me: categories and members are matched or auto-created, with a preview before importing
Home recent bills grouped by date with daily expense/income totals (collapsible); long-press a bill to start multi-select
New Calendar tab: month view with daily expense (today highlighted), tap a date to view its bills
Pie chart shows percentage labels on large slices; tap a slice or a legend row to drill into category details
Category drill-down sheet adds "Subtotals by note" for two-level stats
Fix: version number in Me/About now matches the actual build
Category More: pick from all named icons and replace a pinned category icon
Numeric keypad: swipe or tap the main area to dismiss
Fix: numeric keypad not opening when tapping amount card
Remove page cross-fade for snappier navigation
Expand icon library to 130+ icons in a grid
English name unified to lowercase lalaledger (Chinese name unchanged)
Fix: language switch now applies instantly (previously took two tries)
App renamed to 拉了记账 (lalaledger)
Language: switch between Simplified Chinese and English in-app
Pick date & time when recording (defaults to now) for back-filling
Choose owner (who consumed) and payer (who advanced the money)
Owner/payer pill tags on bill cards and detail page
Stats: switch book, filter by category / owner / payer
AA settle-up: auto balances, simplified transfers, one-tap copy
New guides for trip books and multi-select
All categories laid out (long-press to edit); keyboard no longer closes on scroll
Performance: high refresh rate support, smoother scrolling
Trip books: mark a book as trip book; member features only in trip books
Members: add/edit/delete travel mates with 10-color tags
Owner tagging: assign bills to a member, quick-add on record page
Member pill tags in bill list and detail page
Stats: filter by member to see personal spending
Image export: member tags in summary; single-bill share image
Keyboard: draw-layer slide animation, completely smooth
Record: amount keypad opens on tap, auto-hides after picking category
Edit bills from detail page, full field restore
Receipt thumbnails in bill list with full-screen preview
Export selected bills as a themed PNG summary to gallery
Batch ops: select-all, live totals, delete confirmation
New app icon; removed CSV export
First release: multi-book / quick entry / categories / places
Receipt photos, stats (pie chart + ranking + periods)
